notes.title: Thank you for playing the demo in Steam Next Fest 2023!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the team at CFK.

Thank you for playing the demo of Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem!
Thanks to all of your support, the game saw a great deal of success during the now-concluded Steam Next Fest 2023.

With the conclusion of the Steam Next Fest, the distribution of the demo version of Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem will also end. However, the official version is set for release in the near future, so keep your eyes peeled for news.
Based on the feedback we've gotten from our cherished players, we'll do our best to return with a new and improved version of Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem!

We're always so thankful for the outpouring of support as we at CFK continue to strive to be the best publisher we can be.

Thank you.

🔽Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem official homepage 
https://cfk.kr/koumajou2/en/

notes.title: Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem joins Steam Next Fest 2023!
notes.notes:
Check out the demo of Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem at Steam Next Fest 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340366/6621afcb1e22f4b843d07bc277531b295554d5b0.jpg[/img]

Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem, sequel to side-scrolling action game Koumajou Remilia: Scarlet Symphony, is coming to Steam Next Fest 2023!

Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem is a gothic horror Touhou action game boasting HD graphics, a fully-voiced story by professional voice actresses, and even more content to enjoy.

Popular illustrator Banpai Akira returns, adding a bold, dark edge to the character designs while keeping their original charm, all set to the entertaining action elements of floating amidst a barrage of bullets. On top of that, this powered-up version of the game has been improved in every way, providing players with elegant sound, beautiful graphics, and smooth controls.

In this game, Sakuya Izayoi steps into the role of protagonist, heading to the Scarlet Devil Castle—which was clearly gone before—in search of the missing Remilia, her vanished companions, and the whereabouts of a spring that won't come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340366/210a1142a73ee9571a45585aec0e265b00219261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340366/bbc92b566f6d60301e927dfa2c7abcc0bb8cbcce.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340366/c031fa0b52cb990a921874302f8e737708fb5e87.png[/img]

Will Sakuya be able to find her Scarlet Devil Mansion companions and the whereabouts of the spring that won't come within this colorful hail of bullets...?!
Please check out the demo and show all your support for the release on Thursday, December 14th!

We thank you for all your constant support and will work our hardest to repay the kindness.

Thank you.

🔽Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem official homepage
https://cfk.kr/koumajou2/en/
